primary: Technique used in the main full-constraint method
supporting: Technique operationally used by an adopted method
concept: Subject or explanatory concept; not an executed method
analysis_concept: Proof, complexity, or test-construction concept; not an executed method
full_review_scope: No independent gold labels. Full review means all tags of the recorded feasible reference methods were assessed, not all conceivable methods or 266 independent negatives per problem.
unadopted_candidates: Recorded in uncertainty and excluded from the accepted tags
